registered: 2026-10-22, before any Challenge 1 output of this study was computed

changelog.note: initial registration; design choices made during the synthetic self-test are in notes/DECISIONS.md (D0.1-D0.5)

purpose: Test the submitted anchor + graphite-step method (MyModel, commit 6525edf) end to end on the six Challenge 1 cells, the same 102 Ah LFP cell type, where every cycle carries a discharge-capacity label. The information structure of the pack (one anchor charge per month, a few partial-depth programs) is emulated on each cell; the submitted decision logic runs unchanged.

data.c1_dir_default: /Users/shane/Desktop/Arena 阶段 2 官方材料/dataset original

structure.note: Structural thresholds come from cycles that start inside the first reference_days only, so a cut at any later boundary cannot change them. Labels never select input cycles.

information_structure.label0_rule: label of the anchor-0 cycle itself (its discharge directly follows the anchor charge, as CK0 sits right next to the post-CK0 anchor); a median over later cycles would carry the fast break-in into eps0

pack_analogue.visible_depth_ah: the pack's ~5-day program reaches 55.9 Ah below the CV end
pack_analogue.visible_charge_top_ah: the pack's periodic CCCV charges span about 21 Ah (round 3, stage B)
pack_analogue.program_spacing_days: one deep program roughly every 5 days
pack_analogue.gap_hide_days: the last visible step before CK2 lies 22 days before it (segment 3 missing)

steps.note: robust = the submitted six-variant median with current bands scaled by |I_dis| / pack_ref_current_a, locators unchanged. robust_interp = the same, but the midpoint-type locators interpolate the threshold crossing linearly between samples (adaptation to 30 s sampling at 0.5C/1C; not submitted code). vN = submitted variant N alone; iN = variant N with the interpolated crossing (the dV/dQ variant, N = 4, is the same in both).

model.note: Setpoints here are role labels, not temperatures: they make the submitted code treat anchor 0 as the CK0-calibrated anchor, later anchors as the anchors that enter beta, and every program as a phase-matchable step. Each cell runs at one chamber temperature, so EPS_EXTRA_AH (the 25/45 degC anchor offset) is 0 and the Arrhenius clock is uniform.

baseline.note: ExampleModel uses 13.4 V on the 4S pack = 3.35 V per cell, the median of the last 3 partial charges, and the first segment's median as reference.

estimators.E0_anchor: submitted MyModel with no steps visible: last anchor + eps0
estimators.E1_fallback: submitted MyModel with the phase branch disabled: anchor + step change since the anchor, beta 1
estimators.E2_SUB: submitted MyModel unchanged (phase-matched month-end steps x V2 beta, fallback, sqrt gap rule)
estimators.E2_beta_oracle: E2 with beta = least-squares ratio from the cell's other windows (truth-based, leave-one-window-out; a reference, not causal)
estimators.E4_baseline: ExampleModel analogue: label0 x median(last 3 visible partial charges from 3.35 V) / median(window-0 partial charges)
estimators.E5_trend: linear extrapolation of the last two visible anchors (+ eps0) to the target boundary

noise.delta_rule: delta = max(delta_min_ah, median over scored boundaries of SD(truth_n labels) / sqrt(truth_n))

gates.unit: cell; a cell counts when it has at least min_targets scored targets for the compared estimators

C1_step_update.supported: macro MAE ratio <= 0.70, E2 better on >= ceil(5/6 n) cells, every leave-one-cell-out macro ratio <= 0.80, and the shuffle control fails E2 by >= delta on >= ceil(5/6 n) cells
C1_step_update.not_supported: macro MAE ratio >= 1.00 or E2 better on <= floor(n/2) cells

C1b_beyond_trend.supported: macro MAE gain >= delta and E2 better on >= ceil(2/3 n) cells
C1b_beyond_trend.not_supported: macro MAE loss >= delta or E2 better on <= floor(n/2) cells

C3_beta.supported: macro MAE gain >= delta and E2_SUB better on >= ceil(2/3 n) cells
C3_beta.not_supported: macro MAE loss >= delta or E2_SUB worse on >= ceil(2/3 n) cells
C3_beta.diagnostic: median over cells of |beta_V2 at the last phase target - beta_realised|; > 0.30 is reported as a charge/discharge beta mismatch

C4_phase.compare: E2_SUB vs E1_fallback (targets where the phase branch fired)
C4_phase.supported: macro MAE gain >= delta and better on >= ceil(2/3 n) cells

C5_robust.compare: E2 with the level's robust key vs E2 with each of its single variants (steps.keys_single)
C5_robust.supported: macro MAE of robust <= median over single variants, and within delta of the best single variant
C5_robust.not_supported: macro MAE of robust > median over single variants + delta

C8_vs_baseline.compare: E2_SUB / E4_baseline per cell (MAE ratio, the challenge's normalisation)

C9_gap.compare: gap scenario: E2_SUB (sqrt branch) vs E1_fallback vs E5_trend vs E0_anchor
C9_gap.rule: report only; sqrt(t) is a pack-specific choice (the pack fades like calendar ageing, these cells cycle continuously)

claim_levels.code_as_is: decided on key robust (submitted locators unchanged)

mechanism_checks.C2_step_tracks_capacity: per cell, beta_realised = Theil-Sen and through-origin LS slope of (truth_k - anchor_{k-1} - eps0) on the phase step change x_k; compare with the pack's beta 1.06-1.51 and round 8's 1/b = 1.34 (b 0.745, CI 0.674-0.765)
mechanism_checks.C2b_charge_side: per cell, slope of (Q_anchor_j - Q_anchor_0) on (top_j - top_0) and of (truth_j - truth_0) on (top_j - top_0)
mechanism_checks.C6_step_noise: per window, SD of program depths around their Theil-Sen line; median per cell and key; the pack shows 0.012-0.036 Ah
mechanism_checks.C7_eps_drift: per cell, slope of eps_j = truth(B_j) - Q_anchor(j) on fade (label0 - truth(B_j)); round 11 bound for the pack: -0.036 to +0.052 Ah/Ah
mechanism_checks.C10_truncation: median |robust step on the truncated vs the full discharge| per cell; > 0.05 Ah is flagged
mechanism_checks.C11_rate: detection rate, C6 noise and beta_realised for the 0.5C vs the 1C cells (descriptive)
mechanism_checks.C12_window_overlap: share of programs whose robust step depth is below 27 Ah (the upper plateau window ends at 25 Ah below full)
